# igris.toml reference

`igris.toml` lives in the project root (`igris init` creates it). Every key is optional: a missing key takes the default below. The normative description is [SPEC §12](../SPEC.md).

- Unknown keys are errors, which catches typos.
- Durations use Go syntax (`"30s"`, `"15m"`, `"1h30m"`).
- Secret keys accept `"env:VAR"` to read the value from an environment variable; an unset or empty variable is an error. `igris.toml` holds no secrets by default and is safe to commit.
- `igris config migrate` rewrites a file written by an older release and keeps a backup under `.igris/config/`.

## Top level

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plan` | string | `"tasks.md"` | Path to the plan file, relative to the project root. |
| `backend` | string | `"auto"` | Where agent sessions run (SPEC §11.3). `auto` picks herdr inside a herdr pane, else tmux inside tmux. Allowed: `auto`, `herdr`, `tmux`. |
| `default_mode` | string | `"auto"` | Permission mode of a run when `--mode` is not given (SPEC §7). `yolo` and `plan:yolo` always ask for confirmation. Allowed: `default`, `accept`, `auto`, `plan`, `plan:default`, `plan:accept`, `plan:auto`, `plan:yolo`, `yolo`. |
| `needs_input_after` | duration | `"30s"` | How long a session may sit idle at a prompt before it counts as needing you (SPEC §6.3). Greater than zero. |
| `waiting_limit` | duration | `"30m"` | How long a session may wait on background work before it needs you (SPEC §6.3). Greater than zero. |
| `nudge` | boolean | `true` | Remind an idle agent of `igris done` once before it needs you (SPEC §6.3). |
| `poll_interval` | duration | `"2s"` | How often igris checks the session and refreshes the TUI tail. Greater than zero. |
| `models` | table | `{ fable = "fable", haiku = "haiku", opus = "opus", sonnet = "sonnet" }` | Rank alias to the `claude --model` value. Ranks used in the plan's Model column must be listed here. |
| `columns` | table | empty | Header aliases for the plan table: your header text to the canonical column name (for example `"Depends on" = "Deps"`). |
| `verify` | table | no profiles | Verify profiles: name to shell command (SPEC §6.4). Names match `[a-z0-9_-]+`, `none` is reserved, commands must not be empty. |
| `phases` | table | no phases | Per-phase settings under `[phases.<id>]` (SPEC §6.4); the id matches a plan phase case-insensitively. `verify` is its only key: a profile name, or `none`. |

## `[claude]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `extra_args` | list of strings | `[]` | Arguments appended to every session launch. Model, mode, session, settings, tool, directory, prompt, plugin and MCP flags are rejected, and so are control characters (SPEC §7.4). |

## `[run]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `verify` | string | `""` | Shell command run after a task signals done; the verify profile `default` (SPEC §6.4). Empty means no verification. Cannot be combined with `[verify] default`. |
| `verify_timeout` | duration | `"15m"` | Time limit for every verify profile. Greater than zero. |
| `verify_max_attempts` | integer | `3` | How many times a failing verify is fed back to the agent before the run stops. |
| `commit` | string | `"ask"` | What igris does with the changes after a verified task. Allowed: `ask`, `auto`, `never`. |
| `commit_message` | string | `"{{.ID}}: {{.Title}}"` | Go template for the commit message. Variables include `{{.ID}}` and `{{.Title}}`. |
| `prompt_template` | string | `""` | Path to a custom task prompt template. Empty uses the built-in one. |
| `env` | list of strings | unset | The only variables verify commands and task hooks get, besides `PATH` and `HOME`: names, or prefixes ending in `*` (SPEC §6.4). Unset passes igris's whole environment. |
| `worktree` | boolean | `false` | Run sessions, verify and commits in a git worktree on branch `igris/<run-id>` (SPEC §6.8). |

## `[hooks]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `before_task` | list of strings | `[]` | Argv list run before every agent session, never through a shell (SPEC §6.7). A non-empty list needs a non-empty first element. |
| `after_task` | list of strings | `[]` | Argv list run after every agent session, never through a shell (SPEC §6.7). |
| `timeout` | duration | `"2m"` | Time limit for each hook. Greater than zero. |

## `[plan_mode]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `then` | string | `"auto"` | The mode a plain `plan` task switches to when you approve its plan in igris (SPEC §6.3, §7.1). Never `yolo`. Allowed: `default`, `accept`, `auto`. |
| `approve_timeout` | duration | `"30m"` | How long a plan presented for approval waits for your answer in igris before the pane decides (SPEC §6.3). 1m to 24h; `"0"` approves plans in the pane only. |

## `[usage]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Read the task sessions' transcripts for token usage in the run log (SPEC §6.9). `false` reads none. |
| `statusline` | boolean | `false` | Use igris's status line in task panes to record your subscription quota (5-hour and 7-day usage) for the header and `igris usage` (SPEC §6.3). It replaces your own status line in those panes. `false` leaves it alone and the quota is unavailable. |

## `[side]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | `"sonnet"` | The rank the side-session dialog preselects (SPEC §6.10), a `[models]` key. Unset, `sonnet`, or the first rank when there is none of that name. |
| `mode` | string | `"default"` | The mode the side-session dialog preselects (SPEC §6.10); during a run in the shared tree it preselects `default` whatever this says. Never `yolo` nor a `plan:<mode>` value: side sessions never skip permissions. Allowed: `default`, `accept`, `auto`, `plan`. |

## `[adapt]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | `"sonnet"` | Model rank `igris adapt` uses (SPEC §9). Allowed: `sonnet`, `opus`. |

## `[tui]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mouse` | boolean | `true` | Click/tap, wheel and hover in the TUI (SPEC §15.5). `false` keeps the terminal's own text selection. |
| `theme` | string | `"auto"` | Which colors to use (SPEC §15.4). `auto` goes by the terminal's background. Allowed: `auto`, `dark`, `light`. |
| `rank_colors` | table | empty | Rank to color: `"#rrggbb"` or an ANSI color number `"0"`–`"255"` (SPEC §15.4). Ranks not listed keep the built-in colors. |
| `tail` | boolean | `true` | Live tail of the current session in the task card (SPEC §15.3). `false` makes no tail calls. |

## `[notify]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quiet` | string | `""` (none) | Quiet hours as `HH:MM-HH:MM`, local time, may cross midnight; held messages go out as a digest (SPEC §10). Start and end must differ. |
| `break_through` | list of strings | `["needs_input", "session_lost", "task_overdue"]` | Events never held in quiet hours. `[]` holds everything. Allowed: event names (see below). |
| `task_done_digest` | integer or string | `0` | How `task_done` messages are grouped: `0` or `1` one per task, N ≥ 2 one per N tasks (at most 1000000), `"phase"` one per phase. Allowed: integer, or `"phase"`. |

## `[notify.backend]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | The backend's own toast (herdr, tmux). |

## `[notify.ntfy]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `server` | string | `"https://ntfy.sh"` | ntfy server URL. |
| `topic` | string | `""` | ntfy topic. The channel is off while this is empty. |
| `token` | string | `""` | ntfy access token, or `"env:VAR"` to read it from the environment. |
| `events` | list of strings | `["needs_input", "session_lost", "task_overdue", "rank_mismatch", "phase_done", "phase_stuck", "run_error", "verify_failed_limit"]` | Events sent to ntfy. A file igris writes leaves this out while it is the default list. Allowed: event names (see below). |
| `template` | string | `""` | Message text template (SPEC §10), at most 1000 characters. Empty uses the default text. |

## `[notify.discord]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `webhook_url` | string | `""` | Discord webhook URL (https only), or `"env:VAR"`. The channel is off while this is empty. |
| `events` | list of strings | `["needs_input", "session_lost", "task_overdue", "rank_mismatch", "phase_done", "phase_stuck", "run_error", "verify_failed_limit"]` | Events sent to Discord. Allowed: event names (see below). |
| `template` | string | `""` | Message text template (SPEC §10). |

## `[notify.webhook]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | `""` | Generic webhook URL (http or https), or `"env:VAR"`. The channel is off while url and secret are empty. |
| `secret` | string | `""` | Signs the body (`X-Igris-Signature`), or `"env:VAR"`. A secret without a url is an error. |
| `events` | list of strings | `["needs_input", "session_lost", "task_overdue", "rank_mismatch", "phase_done", "phase_stuck", "run_error", "verify_failed_limit"]` | Events sent to the webhook. Allowed: event names (see below). |
| `template` | string | `""` | Message text template (SPEC §10). |

## `[notify.slack]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `webhook_url` | string | `""` | Slack incoming-webhook URL (https only), or `"env:VAR"`. The channel is off while this is empty. |
| `events` | list of strings | `["needs_input", "session_lost", "task_overdue", "rank_mismatch", "phase_done", "phase_stuck", "run_error", "verify_failed_limit"]` | Events sent to Slack. Allowed: event names (see below). |
| `template` | string | `""` | Message text template (SPEC §10). |

## `[notify.gotify]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `server` | string | `""` | Gotify server URL, for example `https://gotify.example.org`. Needs `token` too. |
| `token` | string | `""` | Gotify application token, or `"env:VAR"`. Needs `server` too. |
| `events` | list of strings | `["needs_input", "session_lost", "task_overdue", "rank_mismatch", "phase_done", "phase_stuck", "run_error", "verify_failed_limit"]` | Events sent to Gotify. Allowed: event names (see below). |
| `template` | string | `""` | Message text template (SPEC §10). |

## Event names

`events` and `break_through` take any of: `needs_input`, `session_lost`, `task_overdue`, `rank_mismatch`, `verify_failed_limit`, `task_done`, `phase_done`, `phase_stuck`, `run_error`.

The default `events` of a channel are `["needs_input", "session_lost", "task_overdue", "rank_mismatch", "phase_done", "phase_stuck", "run_error", "verify_failed_limit"]`; the default `break_through` is `["needs_input", "session_lost", "task_overdue"]`.
